text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lawyer Marios Eliades and former foreign minister George Iakovou remain on the list of communist Akel's candidates for the 1988 presidential elections.
- Stewards union of Cyprus Airways will be taken to court by Alithia newspaper for refusing to allow distribution of the publication on flights.
- President Glafcos Clerides denies he pledged to the United States to ban Greek military flights over Cyprus.
- Indirect military talks between the two sides are now held twice a week.
- Akel and Greece's Synaspismos party propose an international diplomatic offensive to promote a solution to the Cyprus problem.
- The United Nations is seeking an improvement of the diplomatic climate in Cyprus while waiting for decisions of the United States and Britain on how they are to proceed on issue.
- The trade union movement is not sure how to reply to proposals of President Clerides on modification of cost of living allowances.
